Create Quarto presentations

Source: R/presentations.R
create_presentation.Rd

Creates one folder per presentation in path_presentations, containing a single <name>.qmd (reveal.js slides) and the files of the template (theme, logos, ...). Presentations are independent of books: they have their own templates (see list_templates_presentation()) and are rendered with render_presentation().

Usage

create_presentation(
  dirname_presentations,
  path_presentations = "presentations",
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  author = NULL,
  date = NULL,
  lang = "fr",
  template = getOption("kquarto.r.presentation.template", "default-presentation"),
  formats = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  name = NULL,
  path = NULL
)

Arguments

dirname_presentations

Presentation folder names, created in path_presentations. The slides are written in <name>/<name>.qmd.

path_presentations

Folder where the presentation folders are created.

title

Presentation title. A character vector of the same length as dirname_presentations, or named by dirname_presentations to set only some titles. Defaults to dirname_presentations.

subtitle, author, date

Values written in the YAML header of the slides. NULL leaves the template value.

lang

Language of the presentation.

template

Template used to initialise the slides: the name of a presentation template (see list_templates_presentation()), e.g. "default-presentation" or "inrae-presentation" (INRAE graphic charter), a template of another package ("pkg::name") or the path to a template folder. Defaults to the option kquarto.r.presentation.template, or "default-presentation".

formats

Formats of the slides. NULL keeps those of the template ("revealjs", HTML). Add "beamer" to get a PDF made with LaTeX (needs a LaTeX distribution, e.g. quarto install tinytex), rendered with render_presentation(output_format = "beamer"). Typst is not available: Quarto has no Typst slides.

overwrite

Whether to replace the slides of an existing presentation.

name, path

Deprecated, use dirname_presentations and path_presentations.

Value

The paths of the .qmd files, invisibly.

Examples

tmp <- tempfile()
dir.create(tmp)
create_presentation(
  "seminaire",
  path_presentations = tmp,
  title = "Mon séminaire",
  author = "Kevin Orlando",
  template = "inrae-presentation"
)
list.files(tmp, recursive = TRUE)
#>  [1] "seminaire/_brand.yml"                 
#>  [2] "seminaire/images/favicon-inrae.png"   
#>  [3] "seminaire/images/inrae-pied.png"      
#>  [4] "seminaire/images/inrae-titre-vert.png"
#>  [5] "seminaire/images/inrae-titre.png"     
#>  [6] "seminaire/images/logo-inrae.png"      
#>  [7] "seminaire/inrae-beamer.tex"           
#>  [8] "seminaire/inrae-charte.scss"          
#>  [9] "seminaire/inrae-slides.scss"          
#> [10] "seminaire/seminaire.qmd"
